subject.title: Show model-scoped weekly rows before Daily Routines

question: Should the Claude card adopt this fixed scoped-weekly-before-Daily-Routines ordering now, rather than wait for a configurable order or visibility policy?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically narrow and proven, but it selects one of two product directions explicitly described in the related issue; code review cannot determine the permanent UI policy alone.

options.title: Adopt the fixed order
options.body: Merge the narrow reorder now and retain configurable ordering or visibility as separate future work if users still need it.

options.title: Wait for configurable controls
options.body: Pause this PR and resolve the broader optional-row order and visibility policy before changing the default presentation.

recommendation.title: Adopt the fixed order
recommendation.body: Merge the narrow reorder now and retain configurable ordering or visibility as separate future work if users still need it.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository-owned product decision is not resolved by the implementation or related issue discussion.
